about_short_description.short_description: CYPHER develops software solutions for real-time noise reduction, signal identification, and signal extraction on various devices.

product.name: Audio Amplifiers
product.description: Integrated circuits that amplify audio signals for various consumer and mobile devices.

product.name: Audio Codecs
product.description: Integrated circuits that encode and decode audio signals for playback and recording in electronic devices.

product.name: Audio A/D and D/A Converters
product.description: Integrated circuits that convert analog audio signals to digital and digital audio signals to analog for processing and playback.

product.name: Audio DSPs (Digital Signal Processors)
product.description: Processors that perform real-time audio signal processing tasks such as noise reduction and audio enhancement.

product.name: Boosted Amplifiers
product.description: Audio amplifiers with integrated power converters designed to deliver higher loudness and bass in mobile and consumer devices.

product.name: Haptic Drivers
product.description: Integrated circuits that control vibration motors to provide tactile feedback in electronic devices.
